The '''Corporate Committee''' was a power-sharing body that was established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[244Core]] in about [[100 BBY/Legends|100 BBY]]. The committee was made up of representatives of every company that operated on 244Core, and it was responsible for electing the world's [[Chief Administrator/Legends|Chief Administrator]].
